objs.name: document
objs.description: Core document entity representing policies, guidelines, work instructions and other documents.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Comments or links to other documents, master data, or systems.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Interactions with IT applications relevant to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas where the document is applicable.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Business areas or scopes where the document is valid.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification of documents by level or category such as Level 2 Guidelines, Level 4 Work Instructions.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A file attached to a document that is part of the release process.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Non-release-critical information associated with a document.

objs.name: equippments
objs.description: Equipment related to a document, treated as a separate object with its own versioning.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and individuals for distribution and acknowledgement.
